'''Vitun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. During the [[Third Galactic War]], he was stationed at the [[Joint Operations Base]] of the [[Invasion Zone]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], where he provided teaching to [[Jedi Consular]]s.<ref name="Legacy" />
